uncited: **Preprocessing:** Apply zero-padding or vignetting correction to mitigate boundary artifacts caused by periodic boundary assumptions [S3, 841-gpu-based-2d-fft.md, 952-frequency-domain-volume-rendering.md].

Shift the spatial origin to the center of the volume (e.g., via `fftshift` or multiplication by $(-1)^{x+y+z}$) to center the zero-frequency component [S12, 2288-fourier-transform.md, 952-frequency-domain-volume-rendering.md].
**Global Transformation (3D DHT):** Compute the 3D Discrete Hartley Transform (DHT) of the preprocessed volume to obtain the 3D spectrum $H(\omega_1, \omega_2, \omega_3)$.
The 3D transform is separable, applied along each dimension.

**Slice Extraction:** For a viewing direction vector $V$, define a 2D plane passing through the origin of the frequency domain and perpendicular to $V$ [S3, 824-fourier-projection-slice-volume-rendering.md, 6324-hartley-transform.md].
Interpolation (e.g., Trilinear, Windowed Sinc) is required as the plane rarely coincides with the integer lattice [S3, 824-fourier-projection-slice-volume-rendering.md, 6324-hartley-transform.md].
The output resolution must satisfy the Nyquist criterion [S2, 952-frequency-domain-volume-rendering.md, 5396-dct-based-volume-rendering.md].
*   **Interpolation:** Nearest Neighbor, Trilinear, Tri-cubic, or Windowed Sinc [S2, 952-frequency-domain-volume-rendering.md].
Without zero-padding or windowing, discontinuities at volume boundaries cause high-frequency artifacts [S3, 841-gpu-based-2d-fft.md, 952-frequency-domain-volume-rendering.md].

*   **Aliasing:** Insufficient resolution in the slice extraction step violates the Nyquist criterion, causing aliasing [S2, 952-frequency-domain-volume-rendering.md, 5396-dct-based-volume-rendering.md].
